payload.description_html: 3D renderings of a mandible of Plesiobaena antiqua (TMP 1992.40.33). (a) Dorsal view, (b) ventral view, (c) right mandibular ramus in lateral view, (d) right mandibular ramus in medial view, (e) close-up of articular area of left mandibular ramus, (f) close-up of articular area of right mandibular ramus in lateral view. ang, angular; art, articular; cor, coronoid; den, dentary; fat, foramen auriculotemporalis; fdfm, foramen dentofacialis major; fim, foramen intermandibulare medius; fM, fossa Meckelii; pctf, posterior chorda tympani foramen; pre, prearticular; sM, sulcus Meckelii; spl, splenial; sur, surangular.
